description: 远程先手对王：双王相距五排，1.Kd4 构成远程对王，逐步缩短距离，踏关键格赢棋

intro.popup_en: The same principle works with distant opposition. White has the move and can establish the opposition from far away.
intro.popup: 💡 远程先手对王：基本规律不变，远程先手对王！主动权在手。

outro.popup_en: Mastering the opposition is essential in king-and-pawn endings. White shortens the distance, reaches the key squares, and promotes.
outro.popup: 🏆 结论：掌握先手对王是兵王残局的核心要点！

moves.popup_en: 1. Kd4! The white king enters the d-file, three squares from the black king on d8. The odd-numbered distance gives White the distant opposition.
moves.popup: ⭐ 1.Kd4! — 白王进入 d 列，与黑王 Kd8 同列间距 3 格（奇数）= 远程先手对王！

moves.popup_en: ...Ke8: the black king sidesteps to avoid the opposition on the d-file.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke8 — 黑王侧移，回避 d 列对王。

moves.popup_en: 2. Ke5: the white king keeps advancing and maintains pressure.
moves.popup: ♔ 2.Ke5 — 白王继续向上逼近，保持压力。

moves.popup_en: ...Kd7: the black king returns to the d-file and closes the distance.
moves.popup: ♚ Kd7 — 黑王回 d7，接近接触。

moves.popup_en: 3. Kd5 takes the close opposition. With the kings on d5 and d7 and Black to move, White has the opposition.
moves.popup: ⭐ 3.Kd5 — 近程先手对王！Kd5 对 Kd7，间距 1 格，白刚走完 = 白有先手对王。

moves.popup_en: ...Ke7: the black king sidesteps to escape the d-file opposition.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke7 — 黑王侧移，逃开 d 列对王。

moves.popup_en: 4. Kc6! The white king takes the flank route to the key squares and prepares to support the pawn.
moves.popup: ⭐ 4.Kc6! — 侧翼绕入关键格区域！后续配合兵推进。

moves.popup_en: ...Ke6: the black king reaches e6 and tries to resist.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke6 — 黑王进入关键格 e6，试图抵抗。

moves.popup_en: 5. d4: the pawn begins advancing.
moves.popup: ♟ 5.d4 — 兵开始前行！

moves.popup_en: ...Ke7: the black king retreats to defend from behind.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke7 — 黑王后退，守住后方。

moves.popup_en: 6. d5: the pawn advances again.
moves.popup: ♟ 6.d5 — 兵继续推进！

moves.popup_en: ...Kd8: the black king returns to the back rank and holds the d-file.
moves.popup: ♚ Kd8 — 黑王退回底线，死守 d 列。

moves.popup_en: 7. Kd6 reaches the key square and takes the opposition. The result is decided.
moves.popup: ⭐ 7.Kd6 — 白王踏上关键格d6， 先手对王！大局已定。

moves.popup_en: ...Ke8: the black king continues to resist from the back rank.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke8 — 黑王仍在底线挣扎。

moves.popup_en: 8. Kc7: the white king escorts the pawn forward.
moves.popup: ♔ 8.Kc7 — 白王护兵前进。

moves.popup_en: ...Ke7: the black king makes one last attempt to approach.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke7 — 黑王最后一搏，贴近白王。

moves.popup_en: 9. d6+! The pawn checks and forces the black king to give way.
moves.popup: 🔥 9.d6+! — 兵将军！黑王被迫让路。

moves.popup_en: ...Ke6: the black king has to move next to the pawn.
moves.popup: ♚ Ke6 — 黑王只能贴兵，螳臂当车。

moves.popup_en: 10. d7: the pawn is one step from promotion.
moves.popup: ♟ 10.d7 — 兵距升变一步之遥！

moves.popup_en: ...Kd5: the black king runs, but it is too late.
moves.popup: ♚ Kd5 — 黑王跑离，无力回天。

moves.popup_en: 11. d8=Q+ promotes with check. White wins. Starting with distant opposition, White shortened the distance, reached the key squares, and promoted.
moves.popup:
👑 11.d8=Q+ — 升后将军，白方全胜！
从远程对王起步，缩短距离，踏上关键格，完成升变。
